# JPMorgan Chase Quantitative Research Virtual Experience

::: {.hero-lead}
Pricing and risk modeling for an energy trading use case, with forecasting and credit risk framing.
:::

::: {.metrics-grid}
::: {.detail-card}
### Objective
Support contract valuation and credit risk decisions in an energy trading context.
:::

::: {.detail-card}
### Methods
Time-series forecasting, PD modeling, and FICO-based segmentation.
:::

::: {.detail-card}
### Outcome
Estimated expected loss, storage value, and one-year-ahead price forecasts for decision support.
:::
:::
